description: This file contains shell script tests for verifying git behavior with symlinks when using commands like 'update-index' and 'add'. It sets up symlinks, performs operations expected to fail, and checks the repository state.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success based on a description and a command sequence.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command which is expected to fail, validating error handling.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files to verify correctness.
